variables.name: STUDYID
variables.label: Study Identifier
variables.description: Unique identifier for a study.

variables.name: DOMAIN
variables.label: Domain Abbreviation
variables.description: Two-character abbreviation for the domain.

variables.name: USUBJID
variables.label: Unique Subject Identifier
variables.description: Identifier used to uniquely identify a subject across all studies for all applications or submissions involving the product.

variables.name: HOSEQ
variables.label: Sequence Number
variables.description: Sequence number given to ensure uniqueness of subject records within a domain. May be any valid number.

variables.name: HOGRPID
variables.label: Group ID
variables.description: Used to tie together a block of related records in a single domain for a subject.

variables.name: HOREFID
variables.label: Reference ID
variables.description: Internal or external healthcare encounter identifier.

variables.name: HOSPID
variables.label: Sponsor-Defined Identifier
variables.description: Sponsor-defined identifier. May be preprinted on the CRF as an explicit line identifier or defined in the sponsor's operational database. Example: Line number on a Healthcare Encounters CRF page.

variables.name: HOTERM
variables.label: Healthcare Encounter Term
variables.description: Verbatim or preprinted CRF term for the healthcare encounter.

variables.name: HODECOD
variables.label: Dictionary-Derived Term
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C171444
variables.description: Dictionary or sponsor-defined derived text description of HOTERM or the modified topic variable (HOMODIFY).

variables.name: HOCAT
variables.label: Category for Healthcare Encounter
variables.description: Used to define a category of topic-related values.

variables.name: HOSCAT
variables.label: Subcategory for Healthcare Encounter
variables.description: A further categorization of HOCAT values.

variables.name: HOPRESP
variables.label: Pre-Specified Healthcare Encounter
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66742
variables.description: A value of "Y" indicates that this healthcare encounter event was prespecified on the CRF. Values are null for spontaneously reported events (i.e., those collected as free-text verbatim terms).

variables.name: HOOCCUR
variables.label: Healthcare Encounter Occurrence
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66742
variables.description: Used when the occurrence of specific healthcare encounters is solicited, to indicate whether an encounter occurred. Values are null for spontaneously reported events.

variables.name: HOSTAT
variables.label: Completion Status
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66789
variables.description: The status indicates that the prespecified question was not answered.

variables.name: HOREASND
variables.label: Reason Healthcare Encounter Not Done
variables.description: Describes the reason data for a prespecified event were not collected. Used in conjunction with HOSTAT when value is "NOT DONE".

variables.name: TAETORD
variables.label: Planned Order of Element within Arm
variables.description: Number that gives the planned order of the element within the arm.

variables.name: EPOCH
variables.label: Epoch
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C99079
variables.description: Epoch associated with the start date/time of the healthcare encounter. Examples: "SCREENING", "TREATMENT", "FOLLOW-UP".

variables.name: HODTC
variables.label: Date/Time of Event Collection
variables.description: Collection date and time of the healthcare encounter.

variables.name: HOSTDTC
variables.label: Start Date/Time of Healthcare Encounter
variables.description: Start date/time of the healthcare encounter (e.g., date of admission).

variables.name: HOENDTC
variables.label: End Date/Time of Healthcare Encounter
variables.description: End date/time of the healthcare encounter (e.g., date of discharge).

variables.name: HODY
variables.label: Study Day of Event Collection
variables.description: Study day of event collection relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC.

variables.name: HOSTDY
variables.label: Study Day of Start of Encounter
variables.description: Study day of the start of the healthcare encounter relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC.

variables.name: HOENDY
variables.label: Study Day of End of Healthcare Encounter
variables.description: Study day of the end of the healthcare encounter relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC.

variables.name: HODUR
variables.label: Duration of Healthcare Encounter
variables.description: Collected duration of the healthcare encounter. Used only if collected on the CRF and not derived from the start and end date/times. Example: "P1DT2H" (for 1 day, 2 hours).

variables.name: HOSTRTPT
variables.label: Start Relative to Reference Time Point
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66728
variables.description: Identifies the start of the observation as being before or after the sponsor-defined reference time point defined by variable --STTPT. \n Not all values of the codelist are allowable for this variable. See Section 4.4.7, Use of Relative Timing Variables.

variables.name: HOSTTPT
variables.label: Start Reference Time Point
variables.description: Description or date/time in ISO 8601 character format of the sponsor-defined reference point referred to by STRTPT. Examples: "2003-12-15", "VISIT 1".

variables.name: HOENRTPT
variables.label: End Relative to Reference Time Point
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66728
variables.description: Identifies the end of the event as being before or after the reference time point defined by variable HOENTPT. \n Not all values of the codelist are allowable for this variable. See Section 4.4.7, Use of Relative Timing Variables.

variables.name: HOENTPT
variables.label: End Reference Time Point
variables.description: Description or date/time in ISO 8601 character format of the reference point referred to by HOENRTPT. Examples: "2003-12-25", "VISIT 2".
